title: FPV pack: batteries, fleet, builds and blackbox behind the manifest
goal: All FPV tools, tables, phrases, captions and panels come from one pack
acceptance: No FPV import left in store.ts, runtime-chat.ts, telegram.ts or server.ts outside the pack registration
Existing FPV tests pass unchanged; a test shows FPV off hides its tools and keeps its data
privacy: Owner fleet and kitchen data stay local-only; tests use invented batteries, drones and recipes.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-20: move wiring out of four core files into the pack. Not a measurement.
